collection.title: VW ID Buzz 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW ID Buzz 2022 Onwards model requires a 28" blade for both the driver and the passenger side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
